# runr_gateway (Resource)

Your API gateway in a region ([API product](https://runr.sh/docs/api-product/)): `https://<user>.<region>.<base domain>` or its custom domain, routing by path to projects (`runr_gateway_route`). Every member has one gateway per region: the resource takes the existing one or creates it, and manages its IP rate limit, public developer page and custom domain.

The API cannot delete a gateway: destroying the resource resets what it manages (no rate limit, no developer page, no description, no custom domain) and forgets the gateway; its routes, consumers and plans are resources of their own.

Import with the gateway id or the name or id of its region: `terraform import runr_gateway.eu eu-1`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Your gateway in eu-1 (taken over when you have one there): an IP rate limit, the public
# developer page and a custom domain.
resource "runr_gateway" "eu" {
  region_id      = data.runr_region.eu.id
  rate_limit     = { average = 100, burst = 200 }
  developer_page = true
  description    = "The Orders API of Example Ltd."
  custom_domain  = "api.example.com"
}

# While the domain waits, publish these records at your DNS provider, then set verify = true
# (or run `runr gateway domain verify eu-1`).
output "domain_records" {
  value = {
    verification = runr_gateway.eu.custom_domain_verification
    targets      = runr_gateway.eu.custom_domain_dns_targets
  }
}

output "developer_page" {
  value = runr_gateway.eu.developer_page_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_id` (String) Region id (`data.runr_region`). The gateway routes to the workloads that run there. Changing it manages the gateway of the other region.

### Optional

- `custom_domain` (String) The gateway's own domain, e.g. `api.example.com`. It waits until RunR finds the TXT record (`custom_domain_verification`) and one of the records in `custom_domain_dns_targets`, then the routes answer on it (`verify = true` waits for that, or run `runr gateway domain verify`). Changing it requests the new name, the verified one serves until the new one verifies. Left out: none (a domain the gateway has is removed).
- `description` (String) Text of the developer page. Left out: kept as it is; `""` removes it.
- `developer_page` (Boolean) Publish the public developer page at `developer_page_url`: the description, base URLs, routes and how to send a key or token, without sign-in. Left out: kept as it is (a new gateway has none).
- `developer_page_metrics` (Boolean) The developer page also shows each key or JWT route's success rate and latency of the last 7 days (never call counts or consumers). Left out: kept as it is (default `false`).
- `rate_limit` (Attributes) Rate limit per client IP for every route of the gateway (Traefik, requests per second). Left out: none (a limit the gateway has is removed). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limit))
- `verify` (Boolean) Wait until the custom domain is verified (default `false`). While the domain waits, every plan checks it again.
- `verify_timeout` (String) How long `verify` waits (Go duration, default `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `custom_domain_dns_targets` (List of Object) Records that route the domain to the gateway, any one of them (`type`, `name`, `value`: a CNAME to `host`, or an address of the region), while the domain waits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_domain_dns_targets))
- `custom_domain_verification` (Attributes) The TXT record that proves the domain (`type`, `name`, `value`), while it waits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_domain_verification))
- `custom_domain_verified` (Boolean) Whether `custom_domain` is verified and served.
- `developer_page_key` (String) Key of the developer page, while it is published.
- `developer_page_url` (String) URL of the developer page, while it is published.
- `host` (String) Default host of the gateway.
- `id` (String) Gateway id.
- `status` (String) `active`, `pending` or `error` (e.g. the key and JWT routes answer 503 until the region's gateway-auth is ready).
- `status_message` (String) Why the gateway is pending or in error.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain (your user name).

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limit`

Required:

- `average` (Number) Requests per second (1-100000).

Optional:

- `burst` (Number) Requests at once (1-100000). Left out: `average` for a new limit or a changed average, else the gateway's burst stays.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_domain_dns_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_domain_dns_targets`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--custom_domain_verification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_domain_verification`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name (`_runr-challenge.<domain>`).
- `type` (String) `TXT`.
- `value` (String) Record value (`runr-verify=<token>`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <gateway id, or the name or id of its region>
terraform import runr_gateway.eu eu-1
```
